placements.title: value relocates from the rented substrate to the owned perspective
placements.frame: Does this expression relocate value away from a rented or commoditized substrate and onto the individually-owned perspective that is kept?
placements.why: src-2 draws the owned/rented distinction and src-3 completes it by naming the substrate a commodity and the perspective the retained asset — together a single directional claim about where the value of intelligence actually resides, not a one-time fact. Nothing in the supplied graph structure or strata (both empty for this repo) or the perspective's map/area-index/focus witness section covers owned-vs-rented intelligence or perspective-as-asset, so no reuse target exists; this is the seed leaf for that theme. The grain test is satisfied: future envelopes can keep feeding this same directional claim (owned vs. rented, substrate vs. kept asset) rather than it being a single measurement or event.
